concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-server-sdk-deprecation-policy]] - server SDK lifecycle categories, deprecation and processing-risk guidance, two-year update recommendation, and per-SDK README route for version-specific status and dates
warnings: Treat Active, Inactive, Deprecated and Unsupported as policy categories, not proof of the current status of a particular SDK version.
Do not present retained package versions or collection success as current support evidence.
Preserve the one-year post-deprecation processing statement, immediate-upgrade guidance and unsupported-version suspension risk.
Use the applicable current SDK README and release authority for version-specific status and deprecation dates.
